verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Showing their strength, these hymns for grace, Free-givers I have gone to you, devoted, as to battle. For glory have they gone, as milk to Soma, to Indra-Varuna my thoughts and praises.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To Indra and to Varuna, desirous of gaining wealth have these my thoughts proceeded. They have come nigh to you as treasure lovers, like mares, fleet-footed, eager for the glory.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May we ourselves be lords of during riches, of ample sustenance for car and hones. So may the Twain who work with newest succours bring yoked teams hitherward to us and riches.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come with your mighty succours, O ye Mighty; come, Indra-Varuna, to us in battle. What time the flashing arrows play in combat, may we through you be winners in the contest.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I AM the royal Ruler, mine is empire, as mine who sway all life are all Immortals. Varuna's will the Gods obey and follow. I am the King of men's most lofty cover.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I am King Varuna. To me were given these first existing high celestial powers. Varuna's will the Gods obey and follow. I am the King of men's most lofty cover.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I Varuna am Indra: in their greatness, these the two wide deep fairly-fashioned regions, These the two world-halves have I, even as Tvastar knowing all beings, joined and held together.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I made to flow the moisture-shedding waters, and set the heaven firm in the scat of Order. By Law the Son of Aditi, Law Observer, hath spread abroad the world in threefold measure.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Heroes with noble horses, fain for battle, selected warriors, call on me in combat. I Indra Maghavan, excite the conflict; I stir the dust, Lord of surpassing vigour.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: All this I did. The Gods' own conquering power never impedeth me whom none opposeth. When lauds and Soma juice have made me joyful, both the unbounded regions are affrighted.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: All beings know these deeds of thine thou tellest this unto Varuna, thou great Disposer! Thou art renowned as having slain the Vrtras. Thou madest flow the floods that were obstructed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Our fathers then were these, the Seven his, what time the son of Durgaha was captive. For her they gained by sacrifice Trasadasyu, a demi-god, like Indra, conquering foemen.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The spouse of Purukutsa gave oblations to you, O Indra-Varuna, with homage. Then unto her ye gave King Trasadasyu, the demi-god, the slayer of the foeman.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May we, possessing much, delight in riches, Gods in oblations and the kine in pasture; And that Milch-cow who shrinks not from the milking, O Indra-Varuna, give to us daily.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WHO will hear, who of those who merit worship, which of all Gods take pleasure in our homage? On whose heart shall we lay this laud celestial, rich with fair offerings, dearest to Immortals?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Who will be gracious? Who will come most quickly of all the Gods? Who will bring bliss most largely? What car do they call swift with rapid coursers? That which the Daughter of the Sun elected.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So many days do ye come swiftly hither, as Indra to give help in stress of battle. Descended from the sky, divine, strong-pinioned, by which of all your powers are ye most mighty?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: What is the prayer that we should bring you, Asvins, whereby ye come to us when invocated? Whether of you confronts e'en great betrayal? Lovers of sweetness, Dasras, help and save us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In the wide space your chariot reacheth heaven, what time it turneth hither from the ocean. Sweets from your sweet shall drop, lovers of sweetness! These have they dressed for you as dainty viands.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let Sindhu with his wave bedew your horses: in fiery glow have the red birds come hither. Observed of all was that your rapid going, whereby ye were the Lords of Siirya's Daughter.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whene'er I gratified you here together, your grace was given us, O ye rich in booty. Protect, ye Twain, the singer of your praises: to you, Nasatyas, is my wish directed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WE will invoke this day your car, farspreading, O Asvins, even the gathering, of the sunlight,- Car praised in hymns, most ample, rich in treasure, fitted with seats, the car that beareth Surya.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Asvins, ye gained that glory by your Godhead, ye Sons of Heaven, by your own might and power. Food followeth close upon your bright appearing when stately horses in your chariot draw you.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Who bringeth you to-day for help with offered oblation, or with hymns to drink the juices? Who, for the sacrifice's ancient lover, turneth you hither, Asvins, offering homage?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Borne on your golden car, ye omnipresent! come to this sacrifice of ours, Nasatyas. Drink of the pleasant liquor of the Soma give riches to the people who adore you.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come hitherward to us from earth, from heaven, borne on your golden chariot rolling lightly. Suffer not other worshippers to stay you here are ye bound by earlier bonds of friendship.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now for us both, mete out, O Wonder Workers, riches exceeding great with store of heroes, Because the men have sent you praise, O Asvins, and Ajamilhas come to the laudation.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whene'er I gratified you here together, your grace was given us, O ye rich in booty. Protect, ye Twain, the singer of your praises: to you, Nasatyas, is my wish directed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: YONDER goes up that light: your chariot is yoked that travels round upon the summit of this heaven. Within this car are stored three kindred shares of food, and a skin filled with meath is rustling as the fourth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Forth come your viands rich with store of pleasant meath, and cars and horses at the flushing of the dawn, Stripping the covering from the surrounded gloom, and spreading through mid-air bright radiance like the Sun.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Drink of the meath with lips accustomed to the draught; harness for the meath's sake the chariot that ye love. Refresh the way ye go, refresh the paths with meath: hither, O Asvins, bring the skin that holds the meath.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The swans ye have are friendly, rich in store of meath, gold-pinioned, strong to draw, awake at early morn, Swimming the flood, exultant, fain for draughts that cheer: ye come like flies to our libations of-the meath.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Well knowing solemn rites and rich in meath, the fires sing to the morning Asvins at the break of day, When with pure hands the prudent energetic priest hath with the stones pressed out the Soma rich in meath.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The rays advancing nigh, chasing with day the gloom, spread through the firmament bright radiance like the Sun; And the Sun harnessing his horses goeth forth: ye through your Godlike nature let his paths be known.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Devout in thought I have declared, O Asvins, your chariot with good steeds, which lasts for ever, Wherewith ye travel swiftly through the regions to the prompt worshipper who brings oblation.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: DRINK the best draught of Soma-juice, O Vayu, at our holy rites: For thou art he who drinketh first.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come, team-drawn, with thy hundred helps, with Indra, seated in the car, Vaya, and drink your fill of juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May steeds a thousand bring you both, Indra. and Vayu, hitherward To drink the Soma, to the feagt.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For ye, O Indra-Vayu, mount the golden seated car that aids The sacrifice, that reaches heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: On far-refulgent chariot come unto the man who offers gifts: Come, Indra-Vayu, hitherward.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Here, Indra-Vayu, is the juice: drink it, accordant with the Gods, Within the giver's dwelling-place.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hither, O Indra-Vayu, be your journey here unyoke your steeds, Here for your draught of Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Vayu, the bright is offered thee, best of the meath at holy rites. Come thou to drink the Soma juice, God, longed-for, on thy team-drawn car.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Vayu, thou and Indra are meet drinkers of these Soma-draughts, For unto you the drops proceed as waters gather to the vale.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra-Vayu, mighty Twain, speeding together, Lords of Strength, Come to our succour with your team, that ye may drink the Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The longed-for teams which ye possess, O Heroes, for the worshipper, Turn to us, Indra-Vayu, ye to whom the sacrifice is paid.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: TASTE offerings never tasted yet, as bards enjoy the foeman's wealth. O Vayu, on refulgent car come to the drinking of the juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Removing curses, drawn by teams, with Indra, seated by thy side, O Vayu, on refulgent car come to the drinking of the juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The two dark treasuries of wealth that wear all beauties wait on thee. O Vayu, on refulgent car come to the drinking of the juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May nine-and-ninety harnessed steeds who yoke them at thy will bring thee. O Vayu, on refulgent car come to the drinking of the juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Harness, O Vayu, to thy car a hundred well-fed tawny steeds, Yea, or a thousand steeds, and let thy chariot come to us with might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: DEAR is this offering in your mouth, O Indra and Brhaspati: Famed is the laud, the gladdening draught.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This lovely Soma is effused, O Indra and Brhaspati, For you, to drink it and rejoice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As Soma-drinkers to our house come, Indra and Brhaspati-and Indra-to drink Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Vouchsafe us riches hundredfold, O Indra, and Brhaspati, With store of horses, thousandfold.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra. and Brhaspati, we call you when the meath is shed, With songs, to drink the Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Drink, Indra and Brhaspati, the Soma in the giver's house: Delight yourselves abiding there.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him who with might hath propped earth's ends, who sitteth in threefold seat, Brhaspati, with thunder, Him of the pleasant tongue have ancient sages, deep-thinking, holy singers, set before them.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Wild in their course, in well-marked wise rejoicing were they, Brhaspati, who pressed around us. Preserve Brhaspati, the stall uninjured, this company's raining, ever-moving birthplace.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Brhaspati, from thy remotest distance have they sat down who love the law eternal. For thee were dug wells springing from the mountain, which murmuring round about pour streams of sweetness.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Brhaspati, when first he had his being from mighty splendour in supremest heaven, Strong, with his sevenfold mouth, with noise of thunder, with his seven rays, blew and dispersed the darkness.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With the loud-shouting band who sang his praises, with thunder, he destroyed obstructive Vala. Brhaspati thundering drave forth the cattle, the lowing cows who make oblations ready.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Serve we with sacrifices, gifts, and homage even thus the Steer of all the Gods, the Father. Brhaspati, may we be lords of riches, with noble progeny and store of heroes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Surely that King by power and might heroic hath made him lord of all his foes' posses-ions, Who cherishes Brhaspati well-tended, adorns and worships him as foremost sharer.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In his own house he dwells in peace and comfort: to him for ever holy food flows richly. To him the people with free will pay homage-the King with whom the Brahman hatb precedence.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He, unopposed, is master of the riches of his own subjects and of hostile people. The Gods uphold that King with their protection who helps the Brahman when he seeks his favour.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, Brhaspati, rainers of treasure, rejoicing at this sacrifice drink the Soma. Let the abundant drops sink deep within you: vouchsafe us riches with full store of heroes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Brhaspati and Indra, make us prosper may this be your benevolence to usward. Assist our holy thoughts, wake up our spirit: weaken the hatred of our foe and rivals.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: FORTH from the darkness in the region eastward this most abundant splendid light hath mounted. Now verily the far-refulgent Mornings, Daughters of Heaven, bring welfare to the people.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The richly-coloured Dawns have mounted eastward, like pillars planted at our sacrifices, And, flushing far, splendid and purifying, unbarred the portals of the fold of darkness.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Dispelling gloom this day the wealthy Mornings urge liberal givers to present their treasures. In the unlightened depth of darkness round them let niggard traffickers sleep unawakened.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Goddesses, is this your car, I ask you, ancient this day, or is it new, ye Mornings, Wherewith, rich Dawns, ye seek with wealth Navagva, Dasagva Angira, the seven-toned singer?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With horses harnessed by eternal Order, Goddesses, swiftly round the worlds ye travel, Arousing from their rest, O Dawns, the sleeping, and all that lives, man, bird, and beast, to motion.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Which among these is eldest, and where is she through whom they fixed the Rbhus' regulations? What time the splendid Dawns go forth for splendour, they are not known apart alike, unwasting.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Blest were these Dawns of old, shining with succour, true with the truth that springs from holy Order; With whom the toiling worshipper, by praises, hymning and lauding, soon attained to riches.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hither from eastward all at once they travel, from one place spreading in the selfsame manner. Awaking, from the seat of holy Order the Godlike Dawns come nigh like troops of cattle.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thus they go forth with undiminished colours, these Mornings similar, in self-same fashion, Concealing the gigantic might of darkness with radiant bodies bright and pure and shining.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Goddesses, O Heaven's refulgent Daughters, bestow upon us wealth with store of children. As from our pleasant place of rest ye rouse us may we be masters of heroic vigour.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Well-skilled in lore of sacrifice, ye Daughters of Heaven, refulgent Dawns, I thus address you. May we be glorious among the people. May Heaven vouchsafe us this, and Earth the Goddess,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THIS Lady, giver of delight, after her Sister shining forth, Daughter of Heaven, hath shown herself.-
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Unfailing, Mother of the Kine, in colour like a bright red mare, The Dawn became the Asvins' Friend.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Yea, and thou art the Asvins' Friend, the Mother of the Kine art thou: O Dawn thou rulest over wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thinking of thee, O joyous One, as her who driveth hate away, We woke to meet thee with our lauds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Our eyes behold thy blessed rays like troops of cattle loosed to feed. Dawn hath filled full the wide expanse.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When thou hast filled it, Fulgent One! thou layest bare the gloom with light. After thy nature aid us, Dawn.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou overspreadest heaven with rays, the dear wide region of mid-air. With thy bright shining lustre, Dawn.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: OF Savitar the God, the sapient Asura, we crave this great gift which is worthy of our choice, Wherewith he freely grants his worshiper defense. This with his rays the Great God hath vouchsafed to us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sustainer of the heaven, Lord of the whole world's life, the Sage, he putteth on his golden-coloured mail. Clear-sighted, spreading far, filling the spacious realm, Savitar hath brought forth bliss that deserveth laud.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He hath filled full the regions of the heaven and earth: the God for his own strengthening waketh up the hymn. Savitar hath stretched out his arms to cherish life, producing with his rays and lulling all that moves.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Lighting all living creatures, ne'er to be deceived, Savitar, God, protects each holy ordinance. He hath stretched out his arms to all the folk of earth, and, with his laws observed, rules his own mighty course.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Savitar thrice surrounding with his mightiness mid-air, three regions, and the triple sphere of light, Sets the three heavens in motion and the threefold earth, and willingly protects us with his triple law.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Most gracious God, who brings to life and lulls to rest, he who controls the world, what moves not and what moves, May he vouchsafe us shelter, -Savitar the God,- for tranquil life, with triple bar against distress.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With the year's seasons hath Savitar, God, come nigh: may he prosper our home, give food and noble sons. May he invigorate us through the days and nights, and may he send us opulence with progeny.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now must we praise and honour Savitar the God: at this time of the day the men must call to him, Him who distributes wealth to Manu's progeny, that he may grant us here riches most excellent.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For thou at first producest for the holy Gods the noblest of all portions, immortality: Thereafter as a gift to men, O Savitar, thou openest existence, life succeeding life.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: If we, men as we are, have sinned against the Gods through want of thought, in weakness, or through insolence, Absolve us from the guilt and make us free from sin, O Savitar, alike among both Gods and men.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: None may impede that power of Savitar the God whereby he will maintain the universal world. What the fair-fingered God brings forth on earth's expanse or in the height of heaven, that work of his stands sure.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To lofty hills thou sendest those whom Indra leads, and givest fixed abodes with houses unto these. However they may fly and draw themselves apart, still, Savitar, they stand obeying thy behest.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May the libations poured to thee thrice daily, day after day, O Savitar, bring us blessing. May Indra, Heaven, Earth, Sindhu with the Waters, Aditi with Adityas, give us shelter.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WHO of you, Vasus, saveth? who protecteth? O Heaven and Earth and Aditi, preserve us, Varuna., Mitra, from the stronger mortal. Gods, which of you at sacrifice giveth comfort?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They who with laud extol the ancient statutes, when they shine forth infallible dividers, Have ordered as perpetual Ordainers, and beamed as holy-thoughted WonderWorkers.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Housewife Goddess, Aditi, and Sindhu, the Goddess Svasti I implore for friendship: And may the unobstructed Night and Morning both, day and night, provide for our protection.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Aryaman, Varuna have disclosed the pathway, Agni as Lord of Strength the road to welfare. Lauded in manly mode may Indra-Visnu grant us their powerful defense and shelter.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I have besought the favourof the Maruts, of Parvata, of Bhaga God who rescues. From trouble caused by man the Lord preserve us; from woe sent by his friend let Mitra save us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agree, through these our watery oblations, Goddesses, Heaven and Earth, with Ahibudhnya. As if to win the sea, the Gharma-heaters have opened, as they come anear, the rivers.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May Goddess Aditi with Gods defend us, save us the saviour God with care unceasing. We dare not stint the sacred food of Mitra and Varuna upon the back of Agni.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni is Sovran Lord of wealth, Agni of great prosperity: May he bestow these gifts on us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hither to us, rich pleasant Dawn, bring many things to be desired, Thou who hast ample store of wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So then may Bhaga, Savitar, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman, Indra, with bounty come to us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: MAY mighty Heaven and Earth, most meet for honour, be present here with light and gleaming splendours; When, fixing them apart, vast, most extensive, the Steer roars loudly in far-reaching courses.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Goddesses with Gods, holy with holy, the Two stand pouring out their rain, exhaustless: Faithful and guileless, having Gods for children, leaders of sacrifice with shining splendours.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sure in the worlds he was a skillful Craftsman, he who produced these Twain the Earth and Heaven. Wise, with his power he brought both realms, together spacious and deep, wellfashioned, unsupported.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Heaven and Earth, with one accord promoting, with high protection as of Queens, our welfare, Far-reaching, universal, holy, guard us. May we, car-borne, through song be victors ever.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To both of you, O Heaven and Earth, we bring our lofty song of praise, Pure Ones! to glorify you both.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ye sanctify each other's form, by your own proper might ye rule, And from of old observe the Law.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Furthering and fulfilling, ye, O Mighty, perfect Mitra's Law. Ye sit around our sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WE through the Master of the Field, even as through a friend, obtain What nourisheth our kine and steeds. In such may he be good to us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As the cow yieldeth milk, pour for us freely, Lord of the Field, the wave that beareth sweetness, Distilling meath, well-purified like butter, and let the. Lords of holy Law be gracious.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sweet be the plants for us. the heavens, the waters, and full of sweets for us be air's mid-region. May the Field's Lord for us be full of sweetness, and may we follow after him uninjured.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Happily work our steers and men, may the plough furrow happily. Happily be the traces bound; happily may he ply the goad.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Suna and Sira, welcome ye this laud, and with the milk which ye have made in heaven Bedew ye both this earth of ours.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Auspicious Sita, come thou near: we venerate and worship thee That thou mayst bless and prosper us and bring us fruits abundantly.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May Indra press the furrow down, may Pusan guide its course aright. May she, as rich in milk, be drained for us through each succeeding year.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Happily let the shares turn up the ploughland, happily go the ploughers with the oxen. With meath and milk Parjanya make us happy. Grant us prosperity, Suna and Sira.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: FORTH from the ocean sprang the wave of sweetness: together with the stalk it turned to Amrta, That which is holy oil's mysterious title: but the Gods' tongue is truly Amrta's centre.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let us declare aloud the name of Ghrta, and at this sacrifice hold it up with homage. So let the Brahman hear the praise we utter. This hath the four-horned Buffalo emitted.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Four are his horns, three are the feet that bear him; his heads are two, his hands are seven in number. Bound with a triple bond the Steer roars loudly: the mighty God hath entered in to mortals.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: That oil in triple shape the Gods discovered laid down within the Cow, concealed by Panis. Indra produced one shape, Surya another: by their own power they formed the third from Vena.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: From inmost reservoir in countless channels flow down these rivers which the foe beholds not. I look upon the streams of oil descending, and lo! the Golden Reed is there among them.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Like rivers our libations flow together, cleansing themselves in inmost heart and spirit. The streams of holy oil pour swiftly downward like the wild beasts that fly before the bowman.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As rushing down the rapids of a river, flow swifter than the wind the vigorous currents, The streams of oil in swelling fluctuation like a red courser bursting through the fences.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Like women at a gathering fair to look on and gently smiling, they incline to Agni. The streams of holy oil attain the fuel, and Jatavedas joyfully receives them.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As maidens dock themselves with gay adornment to join the bridal feast, I now behold them. Where Soma flows and sacrifice is ready, thither the streams of holy oil are running.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Send to our eulogy a herd of cattle bestow upon us excellent possessions. Bear to the Gods the sacrifice we offer the streams of oil flow pure and full of sweetness.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The universe depends upon thy power and might within the sea, within the heart, within all life.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni is wakened by the people's fuel to meet the Dawn who cometh like a milch-cow. Like young trees shooting up on high their branches, his flames are rising to the vault of heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For worship of the Gods the Priest was wakened: at morning gracious Agni hath arisen. Kindled, his radiant might is made apparent, and the great Deity set free from darkness.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When he hath stirred the line of his attendants, with the pure milk pure Agni is anointed. The strength-bestowing gift is then made ready, which spread in front, with tongues, erect, he drinketh.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The spirits of the pious turn together to Agni, as the eyes of all to Sûrya. He, when both Dawns of different hues have borne him, springs up at daybreak as a strong white charger.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The noble One was born at days' beginning, laid red in colour mid the well-laid fuel. Yielding in every house his seven rich treasures, Agni is seated, Priest most skilled in worship.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni hath sat him down, a Priest most skilful, on a sweet-smelling place, his Mother's bosom. Young, faithful, sage, preeminent o’er many, kindled among the folk whom he sustaineth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This Singer excellent at sacrifices, Agni the Priest, they glorify with homage. Him who spread out both worlds by Law Eternal they balm with oil, strong Steed who never faileth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He, worshipful House-Friend, in his home is worshipped, our own auspicious guest, lauded by sages. That strength the Bull with thousand horns possesses. In might, O Agni, thou excellest others.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou quickly passest by all others, Agni, for him to whom thou hast appeared most lovely, Wondrously fair, adorable, effulgent, the guest of men, the darling of the people.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To thee, Most Youthful God! to thee, O Agni, from near and far the people bring their tribute. Mark well the prayer of him who best extols thee. Great, high, auspicious, Agni, is thy shelter.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ascend to-day thy splendid car, O Agni, in splendour, with the Holy Ones around it. Knowing the paths by mid-air's spacious region bring hither Gods to feast on our oblation.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To him adorable, sage, strong and mighty we have sung forth our song of praise and homage. Gavishṭhira hath raised with prayer to Agni this laud far-reaching, like gold light to heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THE youthful Mother keeps the Boy in secret pressed to her close, nor yields him to the Father. But, when he lies upon the arm, the people see his unfading countenance before them.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: What child is this thou carriest as handmaid, O Youthful One? The Consort-Queen hath bome him. The Babe unborn increased through many autumns. I saw him born what time his Mother bare him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I saw him from afar gold-toothed, bright-coloured, hurling his weapons from his habitation, What time I gave him Amrta free from mixture. How can the Indraless, the hymnless harm me?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I saw him moving from the place he dwells in, even as with a herd, brilliantly shining. These seized him not: he had been born already. They who were grey with age again grow youthful.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Who separate my young bull from the cattle, they whose protector was in truth no stranger? Let those whose hands have seized upon them free them. May he, observant, drive the herd to us-ward.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Mid mortal men godless have secreted the King of all who live, home of the people. So may the prayers of Atri give him freedom. Reproached in turn be those who now reproach him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou from the stake didst loose e'en Sunahsepa bound for a thousand; for he prayed with fervour. So, Agni, loose from us the bonds that bind us, when thou art seated here, O Priest who knowest.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou hast sped from me, Agni, in thine anger: this the protector of Gods' Laws hath told me. Indra who knoweth bent his eye upon thee: by him instructed am I come, O Agni.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni shines far and wide with lofty splendour, and by his greatness makes all things apparent. He conquers godless and malign enchantments, and sharpens both his horns to gore the Raksas.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Loud in the heaven above be Agni's roarings with keen-edged weapons to destroy the demons. Forth burst his splendours in the Soma's rapture. The godless bands press round but cannot stayhim.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As a skilled craftsman makes a car, a singer I, Mighty One! this hymn for thee have fashioned. If thou, O Agni, God, accept it gladly, may we obtain thereby the heavenly Waters.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May he, the strong-necked Steer, waxing in vigour, gather the foeman's wealth with none to check him. Thus to this Agni have the Immortals spoken. To man who spreads the grass may he grant shelter, grant shelter to the man who brings oblation.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THOU at thy birth art Varuna, O Agni; when thou art kindled thou becomest Mitra. In thee, O Son of Strength, all Gods are centred. Indra art thou to man who brings oblation.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Aryaman art thou as regardeth maidens mysterious, is thy name, O Self-sustainer. As a kind friend with streams of milk they balm thee what time thou makest wife and lord one-minded.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Maruts deck their beauty for thy glory, yea, Rudra! for thy birth fair, brightly-coloured. That which was fixed as Visnu's loftiest station-therewith the secret of the Cows thou guardest.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Gods through thy glory, God who art so lovely! granting abundant gifts gained life immortal. As their own Priest have men established Agni; and serve him fain for praise from him who liveth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: There is no priest more skilled than thou in worship; none Self-sustainer pass thee in wisdom. Ile man within whose house as guest thou dwellest, O God, by sacrifice shall conquer mortals.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Aided by thee, O Agni may we conquer through our oblation, fain for wealth, awakened: May we in battle, in the days' assemblies, O Son of Strength, by riches conquer mortals.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He shall bring evil on the evil-plotter whoever turns against us sin and outrage. Destroy this calumny of him, O Agni, whoever injures us with double-dealing.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: At this dawn's flushing, God! our ancient fathers served thee with offerings, making thee their envoy, When, Agni, to the store of wealth thou goest, a God enkindled with good things by mortals.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Save, thou who knowest, draw thy father near thee, who counts as thine own son, O Child of Power. O sapient Agni, when wilt thou regard us? When, skilled in holy Law, wilt thou direct us?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Adoring thee he gives thee many a title, when thou, Good Lord! acceptest this as Father. And doth not Agni, glad in strength of Godhead, gain splendid bliss when he hath waxen mighty?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Most Youthful Agni, verily thou bearest thy praiser safely over all his troubles. Thieves have been seen by us and open foemen: unknown have been the plottings of the wicked.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To thee these eulogies have been directed: or to the Vasu hath this sin been spoken. But this our Agni, flaming high, shall never yield us to calumny, to him who wrongs us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O AGNI, King and Lord of wealth and treasures, in thee is my delight at sacrifices. Through thee may we obtain the strength we long for, and overcome the fierce attacks of mortals.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, Eternal Father, offering- bearer, fair to behold, far-reaching, far-refulgent, From well-kept household fire beam food to feed us, and measure out to us abundant glory.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Sage of men, the Lord of human races, pure, purifying Agni, balmed with butter, Him the Omniscient as your Priest ye stablish: he wins among the Gods things worth the choosing.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, enjoy, of one accord with Ila, striving in rivalry with beams of Sarya, Enjoy, O Jatavedas, this our fuel, and bring the Gods to us to taste oblations.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As dear House-Friend, guest welcome in the dwelling, to this our sacrifice come thou who knowest. And, Agni, having scattered all assailants, bring to us the possessions of our foemen.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Drive thou away the Dasyu with thy weapon. As, gaining vital power for thine own body, O Son of Strength, the Gods thou satisfiest, so in fight save us, most heroic Agni.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May we, O Agni, with our lauds adore thee, and with our gifts, fair-beaming Purifier! Send to us wealth containing all things precious: bestow upon us every sort of riches.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Son of Strength, Agni, dweller in three regions, accept our sacrifice and our oblation. Among the Gods may we be counted pious: protect us with a triply-guarding shelter.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Over all woes and dangers, Jatavedas, bear us as in a boat across a river. Praised with our homage even as Atri praised thee, O Agni, be the guardian of our bodies.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As I, remembering thee with grateful spirit, a mortal, call with might on thee Immortal, Vouchsafe us high renown, O Jatavedas, and may I be immortal by my children.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The pious man, O Jatavedas Agni, to whom thou grantest ample room and pleasure, Gaineth abundant wealth with sons and horses, with heroes and with kine for his well-being.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To Agni, Jatavedas, to the flame, the well-enkindled God, Offer thick sacrificial oil.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He, Narasamsa, ne'er beguiled, inspiriteth this sacrifice: For sage is he, with sweets in hand.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Adored, O Agni, hither bring Indra the Wonderful, the Friend, On lightly-rolling car to aid.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Spread thyself out, thou soft as wool The holy hymns have sung to thee. Bring gain to us, O beautiful!
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Open yourselves, ye Doors Divine, easy of access for our aid: Fill, more and more, the sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Fair strengtheners of vital power, young Mothers of eternal Law, Morning and Night we supplicate.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: On the wind's flight come, glorified, ye two celestial Priests of man Come ye to this our sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ila, Sarasvati, Mahi, three Goddesses who bring us weal, Be seated harmless on the grass.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Rich in all plenty, Tvastar, come auspicious of thine own accord Help us in every sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Vanaspati, wherever thou knowest the Gods' mysterious names, Send our oblations thitherward.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To Agni and to Varuna, Indra, the Maruts, and the Gods, With Svaha be oblation brought.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I VALUE Agni that good Lord, the home to which the kine return: Whom fleet-foot coursers seek as home, and strong enduring steeds as home. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: 'Tis Agni whom we laud as good, to whom the milch-kine come in herds, To whom the chargers swift of foot, to whom our well-born princes come. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni the God of all mankind, gives, verily, a steed to man. Agni gives precious gear for wealth, treasure he gives when he is pleased. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: God, Agni, we will kindle thee, rich in thy splendour, fading not, So that this glorious fuel may send forth by day its light for thee. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To thee the splendid, Lord of flame, bright, wondrous, Prince of men, is brought. Oblation with the holy verse, O Agni, bearer of our gifts. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: These Agnis in the seats of the fire nourish each thing most excellent. They give delight, they spread abroad, they move themselves continually. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, these brilliant flames of thine wax like strong chargers mightily, Who with the treadings of their hoofs go swiftly to the stalls of kine. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To us who laud thee, Agni, bring fresh food and safe and happy homes. May we who have sung hymns to thee have thee for envoy in each house. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, brilliant God, within thy mouth warmest both ladies of the oil. So fill us also, in our hymns, abundantly, O Lord of Strength, Bring food to those who sing thy praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thus Agni have we duly served with sacrifices and with hymns. So may he give us what we crave, store of brave sons and fleet-foot steeds. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: OFFER to Agni, O my friends, your seemly food, your seemly praise; To him supremest o'er the folk, the Son of Strength, the mighty Lord:
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him in whose presence, when they meet in full assembly, men rejoice; Even him whom worthy ones inflame, and living creatures bring to life.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When we present to him the food and sacrificial gifts of men, He by the might of splendour grasps the holy Ordinance's rein.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He gives a signal in the night even to him who is afar, When he, the Bright, unchanged by old, consumes the sovrans of the wood.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He in whose service on the ways they offer up their drops of sweat, On him is their high kin have they mounted, as ridges on the earth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whom, sought of many, mortal man hath found to be the Stay of all; He who gives flavour to our food, the home of every man that lives.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Even as a herd that crops the grass he shears the field and wilderness, With flashing teeth and beard of gold, deft with his unabated might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For him, to whom, bright as an axe he, as to Atri, hath flashed forth, Hath the well-bearing Mother borne, producing when her time is come.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni to whom the oil is shed by him thou lovest to support, Bestow upon these mortals fame and splendour and intelligence.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Such zeal hath he, resistless one: he gained the cattle given by thee. Agni, may Atri overcome the Dasyus who bestow no gifts, subdue the men who give no food.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O AGNI urged to strength, the men of old who loved the Law enkindled thee, the Ancient, for their aid, Thee very bright, and holy, nourisher of all, most excellent, the Friend and Master of the home.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thee, Agni, men have stablished as their guest of old, as Master of the household, thee, with hair of flame; High-bannered, multiform, distributor of wealth, kind helper, good protector, drier of the floods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The tribes of men praise thee, Agni, who knowest well burnt offerings, the Discerner, lavishest of wealth, Dwelling in secret, Blest One! visible to all, loud-roaring, skilled in worship, glorified with oil.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ever to thee, O Agni, as exceeding strong have we drawn nigh with songs and reverence singing hymns. So be thou pleased with us, Angiras! as a God enkindled by the noble with man's goodly light.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, Agni! multiform, God who art lauded much! givest in every house subsistence as of old. Thou rulest by thy might o'er food of many a sort: that light of thine when blazing may not be opposed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Gods, Most Youthful Agni, have made thee, inflamed, the bearer of oblations and the messenger. Thee, widely-reaching, homed in sacred oil, invoked, effulgent, have they made the Eye that stirs the thought.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Men seeking joy have lit thee worshipped from of old, O Agni, with good fuel and with sacred oil. So thou, bedewed and waxing mighty by the plants, spreadest thyself abroad over the realms of earth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: BEARING; oblations mortal men, O Agni, worship thee the God. I deem thee Jatavedas: bear our offerings, thou, unceasingly.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In the man's home who offers gifts, where grass is trimmed, Agni is Priest, To whom all sacrifices come and strengthenings that win renown.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whom, as an infant newly-born, the kindling-sticks have brought to life, Sustainer of the tribes of men, skilled in well-ordered sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Yea, very hard art thou to grasp, like offspring of the wriggling snakes, When thou consumest many woods like an ox, Agni, in the mead.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whose flames, when thou art sending forth the smoke, completely reach the mark, When Trta in the height of heaven, like as a smelter fanneth thee, e'en as a smelter sharpeneth thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Agni, by thy succour and by Mitra's friendly furtherance, May we, averting hate, subdue the wickedness of mortal men.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Agni, to our heroes bring such riches, thou victorious God. May he protect and nourish us, and help in gaining strength: be thou near us in fight for our success.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: BRING us most mighty splendour thou, Agni, resistless on thy way. With overflowing store of wealth mark out for us a path to strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ours art thou, wondrous Agni, by wisdom and bounteousness of power. The might of Asuras rests on thee, like Mitra worshipful in act.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, increase our means of life, increase the house and home of these, The men, the princes who have won great riches through our hymns of praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bright Agni, they who deck their songs for thee have horses as their meed. The men are mighty in their might, they whose high laud, as that of heaven, awakes thee of its own accord.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Agni, those resplendent flames of thine go valorously forth, Like lightnings flashing round us, like a rattling car that seeks the spoil.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now, Agni, come to succour us; let priests draw nigh to offer gifts; And let the patrons of our rites subdue all regions of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bring to us, Agni, Angiras, lauded of old and lauded now, Invoker! wealth to quell the strong, that singers may extol thee. Be near us in fight for our success.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THE watchful Guardian of the people hath been born, Agni, the very strong, for fresh prosperity. With oil upon his face, with high heaven touching flame, he shineth splendidly, pure, for the Bharatas.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ensign of sacrifice, the earliest Household-Priest, the. men have kindled Agni in his threefold seat, With Indra and the Gods together on the grass let the wise Priest sit to complete the sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pure , unadorned, from thy two Mothers art thou born: thou camest from Vivasvan as a charming Sage. With oil they strengthened thee, O Agni, worshipped God: thy banner was the smoke that mounted to the sky.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May Agni graciously come to our sacrifice. The men bear Agni here and there in every house. He hath become an envoy, bearer of our gifts: electing Agni, men choose one exceeding wise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For thee, O Agni, is this sweetest prayer of mine: dear to thy spirit be this product of my thought. As great streams fill the river so our song of praise fill thee, and make thee yet more mighty in thy strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Agni, the Angirases discovered thee what time thou layest hidden, fleeing back from wood to wood. Thou by attrition art produced as conquering might, and men, O Angiras, call thee the Son of Strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To Agni, lofty Asura, meet for worship, Steer of eternal Law, my prayer I offer; I bring my song directed to the Mighty like pure oil for his mouth at sacrifices.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Mark the Law, thou who knowest, yea, observe it: send forth the full streams of eternal Order. I use no sorcery with might or falsehood the sacred Law of the Red Steer I follow.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: How hast thou, follower of the Law eternal, become the knower of a new song, Agni? The God, the Guardian of the seasons, knows me: the Lord of him who won this wealth I know not.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Who, Agni, in alliance with thy foeman, what splendid helpers won for them their riches? Agni, who guard the dwelling-place of falsehood? Who are protectors of the speech of liars?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, those friends of thine have turned them from thee: gracious of old, they have become ungracious. They have deceived themselves by their own speeches, uttering wicked words against the righteous.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He who pays sacrifice to thee with homage, O Agni, keeps the Red Steer's Law eternal; Wide is his dwelling. May the noble offspring of Nahusa who wandered forth come hither.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WITH songs of praise we call on thee, we kindle thee with songs of praise, Agni, -with songs of praise, for help.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Eager for wealth, we meditate Agni's effectual praise to-day, Praise of the God who touches heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May Agni, Priest among mankind, take pleasure in our songs of praise, And worship the Celestial Folk.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, Agni, art spread widely forth, Priest dear and excellent; through thee Men make the sacrifice complete.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Singers exalt thee, Agni, well lauded, best giver of our strength: So grant thou us heroic might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou Agni, as the felly rings the spokes, encompassest the Gods. yearn for bounty manifold.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: ENKINDLING the Immortal, wake Agni with song of praise: may he bear our oblations to the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: At high solemnities mortal men glorify him the Immortal, best At sacrifice among mankind.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: That he may bear their gifts to heaven, all glorify him Agni, God, With ladle that distilleth oil.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni shone bright when born, with light killing the Dasyus and the dark: He found the Kine, the Floods, the Sun.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Serve Agni, God adorable, the Sage whose back is balmed with oil: Let him approach, and hear my call.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They have exalted Agni, God of all mankind, with oil and hymns Of praise, devout and eloquent.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To him, the far-renowned, the wise Ordainer, ancient and glorious, a song I offer. Enthroned in oil, the Asura, bliss-giver, is Agni, firm support of noble, riches.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: By holy Law they kept supporting Order, by help of sacrifice, in loftiest heaven,- They who attained with born men to the unborn, men seated on that stay, heaven's firm sustainer.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Averting woe, they labour hard to bring him, the ancient, plenteous food as power resistless. May he, born newly, conquer his assailants: round him they stand as round an angry lion.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When, like a mother, spreading forth to nourish, to cherish and regard each man that liveth,- Consuming all the strength that thou hast gotten, thou wanderest round, thyself, in varied fashion.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May strength preserve the compass of thy vigour, God! that broad stream of thine that beareth riches. Thou, like a thief who keeps his refuge secret, hast holpen Atri to great wealth, by teaching.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: GREAT power is in the beam of light, sing praise to, Agni, to the God Whom men have set in foremost place like Mitra with their eulogies.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He by the splendour of his arms is Priest of every able man. Agni conveys oblation straight, and deals, as Bhaga deals, his boons.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: All rests upon the laud and love of him the rich, high-flaming God, On whom, loud-roaring, men have laid great strength as on a faithful friend.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So, Agni, be the Friend of these with liberal gift of hero strength. Yea, Heaven and Earth have not surpassed this Youthful One in glorious fame.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Agni, quickly come to us, and, glorified, bring precious wealth. So we and these our princes will assemble for the good of all. Be near in fight to prosper us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: GOD, may a mortal call the Strong hither, with solemn rites, to aid, A man call Agni to protect when sacrifice is well prepared.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Near him thou seemest mightier still in native glory, set to hold Apart yon flame-hued vault of heaven, lovely beyond the thought of man.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Yea, this is by the light of him whom powerful song hath bound to act, Whose beams of splendour flash on high as though they sprang from heavenly seed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Wealth loads the Wonder-Worker's car through his, the very wise One's power. Then, meet to be invoked among all tribes, is Agni glorified.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now, too, the princes shall obtain excellent riches by our lips. Protect us for our welfare: lend thy succour, O thou Son of Strength. Be near in fight to prosper us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: AT dawn let: Agni, much-beloved guest of the house, be glorified; Immortal who delights in all oblations brought by mortal men.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For Dvita who receives through wealth of native strength maimed offerings, Thy praiser even gains at once the Soma-drops, Immortal Gods!
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Nobles, with song I call that car of yours that shines with lengthened life, For, God who givest steeds! that car hither and thither goes unharmed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They who have varied ways of thought, who guard, the lauds within their lips, And strew the grass before the light, have decked themselves with high renown.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Immortal Agni, give the chiefs, heroes who institute the rite, Heroes' illustrious, lofty fame, who at the synod met for praise presented me with fifty steeds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: ONE state begets another state: husk is made visible from husk: Within his Mother's side he speaks.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Discerning, have they offered gifts: they guard the strength that never wastes. To a strong fort have they pressed in.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Svaitreya's people, all his men, have gloriously increased in might. A gold chain Brhaduktha wears, as, through this Soma, seeking spoil.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I bring, as 'twere, the longed-for milk, the dear milk of the Sister-Pair. Like to a caldron filled with food is he, unconquered, conquering all.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Beam of light, come to us in sportive fashion, finding thyself close to the wind that fans thee. These flames of his are wasting flames, like arrows keen-pointed, sharpened, on his breast.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: AGNI, best winner of the spoil, cause us to praise before the Gods As our associate meet for lauds, wealth which thou verily deemest wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, the great who ward not off the anger of thy power and might Stir up the wrath and hatred due to one who holds an alien creed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thee, Agni, would we choose as Priest, the perfecter of strength and skill; We who bring sacred food invoke with song thee Chief at holy rites.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Here as is needful for thine aid we toil, O Conqueror, day by day, For wealth, for Law. May we rejoice, Most Wise One! at the feast, with kine, rejoice, with heroes, at the feast.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WE stablish thee as Manus used, as Manus used we kindle thee. Like Manus, for the pious man , Angiras, Agni, worship Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For well, O Agni, art thou pleased when thou art kindled mid mankind. Straight go the ladles unto thee, thou highborn God whose food is oil.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thee have all Gods of one accord established as their messenger. Serving at sacrifices men adore thee as a God, O Sage.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let mortal man adore your God, Agni, with worship due to Gods. Shine forth enkindled, Radiant One. Sit in the chamber of the Law, sit in the chamber of the food.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: LIKE Atri, Visvasaman! sing to him of purifying light, Who must be praised in holy rites, the Priest most welcome in the house.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Set Jatavedas in his place, Agni the God and Minister. Let sacrifice proceed to-day duly, comprising all the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: All mortals come to thee for aid, the God of most observant mind. Of thine excelling favour we bethink us as we long for it.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Mark with attention this our speech, O Agni, thou victorious One. Thee, Strong-jawed! as the homestead's Lord, the Atris with their lauds exalt, the Atris beautify with songs.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: By thy fair splendour's mighty power, O Agni, bring victorious wealth, Wealth that o'ercometh all mankind, and, near us, conquereth in fight.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Victorious Agni, bring to us the wealth that vanquisheth in war; For thou art wonderful and true, giver of strength in herds of kine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For all the folk with one accord, whose sacred grass is trimmed and strewn, Invite thee to their worship-halls, as a dear Priest, for choicest wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For he, the God of all men, hath gotten him might that quelleth foes. O Agni, in these homes shine forth, bright God! for our prosperity, shine, Purifier! splendidly.
